name: Rust Ooze

source.title: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

items.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
items.text: A rust ooze can sense nearby creatures through vibration and air or water movement.

items.name: Corrode Weapon
items.text:
Trigger The rust ooze is hit with a metal weapon

---

Effect The rust ooze deals 2d6 acid damage to the item, ignoring its Hardness.

items.name: Metal Resistance
items.text: A rust ooze has resistance 5 to metal weapons.

items.name: Rust
items.text: When a rust ooze critically succeeds at a pseudopod Strike, it deals 2d6 acid damage to a metal item the target is wearing or holding, ignoring the item's Hardness. If a creature uses the Shield Block reaction with a metal shield against a rust ooze's pseudopod attack, the shield is automatically broken, but no other item is rusted.

items.name: Tetanus
items.text:
An infection introduced through open wounds, tetanus can produce stiffness, muscle spasms strong enough to break bones, and ultimately death.

Saving Throw DC 14 Fortitude save

Onset 10 days

Stage 1 Clumsy 1 (1 week)

Stage 2 Clumsy 2 and can't speak (1 day)

Stage 3 Paralyzed with spasms (1 day)

Stage 4 death

text:
Urban pollution breeds all kinds of new and interesting ooze creatures.

These reddish-brown globs wriggle through sewers and other waterways in search of iron pipes, metal trash, and other objects that rust.
